note: What can change about a place, and where it starts. The lore in placeDossiers is the starting condition, not the eternal condition: this is the machinery that lets a place stop being what was written about it. Dials are attached by TAG so the whole city has them, with per-place overrides where a location has been written up specifically.
dialNote: Segments are the house standard six unless a dial says otherwise. These are local pressures, not the pressure rail: the rail means something is coming for you, and a market's police attention is a fact about a market.

police_attention.label: Police attention
police_attention.meaning: How interested the law has become in what goes on here.

gang_pressure.label: Gang pressure
gang_pressure.meaning: How much somebody is leaning on the people who work here.

goodwill.label: Goodwill
goodwill.meaning: Whether the people here are glad to see the character.

reclaimer_control.label: Reclaimer control
reclaimer_control.meaning: How much of this ground the people who work it still hold.

flagNote: Closed vocabulary. A flag is set by the engine when a dial crosses, or by a beat that resolves; nothing else may write one, and the model may not name one at all.

flags.gang_extortion: Somebody is taking a cut of everything that moves through.
flags.raided: The law has been through, and recently.
flags.shut: Closed. Not temporarily, as far as anyone here knows.
flags.rebuilt: Put back together after something took it apart.
flags.power_out: No power, and no date for its return.

thresholdNote: What happens when a dial fills. This is where a place stops being what the atlas described: a market that draws enough police attention stops being a market, and the entry the player read in week one is now history.

thresholds.note: The law comes through. Trade stops, and the attention drops back but not to nothing: they know about this place now.
Somebody has taken the place over in all but name.
The people who worked this ground are not working it any more.

startNote: Where a specific location starts, when the writing said something specific. Everything not named here starts wherever its tags put it.
